items.title: Victoria ended logging. Now it's using another state's native forests
items.description: Four Corners follows the logs, and the money, to uncover how efforts to end logging have shifted the timber trade across state borders.

items.title: The economic environment is likely to keep favouring One Nation's message
items.description: The problem for both the Coalition and Labor is that things are only going to get more difficult for ordinary families in the years ahead, and the economic environment is likely to keep favouring One Nation’s message.

items.title: Iranian and US negotiators in Switzerland to discuss end to war
items.description: US Vice President JD Vance travels to Switzerland to meet with Iranian leaders and build on the fragile interim deal to end the war in Iran.

items.title: British PM set to resign after challenger's thumping by-election win
items.description: Less than two years after being elected in a landslide, the Labour PM is expected to announce his resignation to make way for another leader.

items.title: Black swan 'wipe-out' predicted as dead birds reported along WA coast

items.title: Live: Spain breezes past Saudis as teen sensation announces World Cup arrival
items.description: Lamine Yamal finds the net on his World Cup starting debut, as Spain makes light work of Saudi Arabia to bounce back from its shock draw with Cabo Verde. Follow live.

items.title: Can Labor handle a backlash over AI and data centres?

items.title: This major change to super payments will start next week

items.title: 'Tesla' cocaine bricks found washed up on Fiji beach

items.title: Colleen Harkin quits Liberal party after praising One Nation

items.title: Auction clearance rates fall to lowest level in six years

items.title: On health and child care, Labor might have found Pauline Hanson's kryptonite

items.title: Mona unveils $100m underground library packed with rare literary treasures

items.title: Trump says Reflecting Pool may be drained for repairs after 'vandalism'

items.title: WA football great Cousins taking inspiration from Daniher in MND fight
